_meta.description: Labour rates per skill as base wage x burden factor (USD/hour) and regional cost factors. fx_per_usd for INR was updated in the 2026-10-11 accuracy review; other currencies are unverified seed values (see fx_source). machine_rate_overrides replace base rate x machine_rate_factor where one factor cannot fit. Replace with your own benchmark data.

CNC_MILL_3AX.source: Set so the all-in hour (machine + operator + overhead + profit) is mid-range of published Indian 3-axis VMC billing rates, INR 750-1,040/h

CNC_MILL_5AX.source: Set so the all-in hour is mid-range of published Indian 5-axis billing rates, INR 3,240-3,900/h

CNC_LATHE.source: Published Indian CNC turning-centre billing rate INR 200-260/h (mid INR 230) applied to the machine share only; the all-in hour cannot reach that range because operator labour at this location's rate is already above it
